newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Simon DeBartolo started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Simon DeBartolo started.

text.p: UBS Securities Inc said Tuesday it started coverage of Simon DeBartolo Group Inc with a strong buy rating and a $36 per share price target.
-- Analyst Mary Hogan said in a research note her 1997 earnings estimate was $2.56 per share and its 1998 estimate was $2.80 per share.
-- Hogan said Simon DeBartolo was the dominant owner and operator of retail real estate in the United States.
-- It had an attractive dividend yield of 6.7 percent compared to a real estate investment trust (REIT) industry average of 6.5 percent, she said.
-- "We expected Simon DeBartolo to continue to play a key role in the consolidation of the regional mall industry...given its size, liquidity and access to capital," Hogan said.
